test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 05 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Two trains 285 metres and 235 metres long are running in the opposite direction with speeds of 61 km/hr and 83 km/hr, resepectively. In how much time will the first train cross the second?3631
solution:
**Given:**

Length of first train = 285

Length of second train = 235

Speed of first train = 61 km/hr

Speed of second train = 83 km/hr

**Formula Used:**

Relative speed (opposite direction) = Sum of speeds

Time = Total distance ÷ Relative speed

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total distance = 285 + 235 = 520

⇒ Relative speed = 61 + 83 = 144 km/hr

⇒ Convert speed into m/s

⇒ 144 × 5 ÷ 18

⇒ = 40 m/s

⇒ Time = 520 ÷ 40

⇒ = 13 seconds

**∴ The correct answer is 13 seconds.**
